description: Updates the shared Event details everyone sees: title, date and time (local time, no time zone; no start_time means all day), location and description. Omitted fields stay unchanged; an empty string clears a field. Use when the user sets or changes the agreed event details or renames the plan.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.
